news.title: Mizzou football's Sterling Webb remains eligible to play
news.lede: Mizzou defensive tackle Sterling Webb remains eligible to play after a St. Louis County judge denied the NCAA's order to dismiss his temporary restraining order Wednesday morning. The judge also added the University of Missouri to the temporary restraining order. The lawsuit challenged the application of NCAA's five-for-five, age-based eligibility model, stating players will have five years to play five seasons immediately following their last year of high school or their 19th birthday.

news.title: Queiroz re-appointed Ghana coach two months after stepping down
news.lede: Carlos Queiroz led Ghana to the round of 32 at the 2026 World Cup. Carlos Queiroz was re-appointed Ghana coach for an indeterminate period on Sept 2, two months after stepping down in the wake of the country’s World Cup campaign. The experienced former Iran, Portugal, Colombia and Egypt coach took the Black Stars to the round of 32 at the World Cup despite having only a couple of months to prepare them for the tournament. The Ghana Football Association (GFA) said the 73-year-old Portuguese coach would “embark on a new coaching mandate, commencing with the upcoming international window”.

news.title: 'Predicted Tragedy': North America and Central America World Cup Failure, Where Did Korean Football Begin to Collapse? [Founding Issue ①]
news.lede: Korean football has faced chaos and crisis, from the collapse of the national team system to the mass resignation of top officials, and the ongoing administrative turmoil of the Football Association still struggling to find a way out. StarNews examines the root causes of the crisis facing Korean football and diagnoses the path toward restoring broken trust and achieving normalization. Editor's Note Following the disastrous performance at the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America and Central America, Korean football has plunged into uncontrollable chaos. Just four years ago, under former coach Paulo Bento, a system built on solid processes and systematic support had secured qualification for the Round of 16 at the 2022 Qatar World Cup — yet that entire framework has now vanished without a trace.

news.title: Messi departure leaves Argentina facing rebuild after golden era
news.lede: BUENOS AIRES: Argentina face a testing transition period as they attempt to move on from Lionel Messi’s international retirement, with question marks also hanging over the futures of coach Lionel Scaloni and several ageing players. Messi vacated the famous number 10 shirt on Monday, after 21 years of carrying Argentinian hopes on his shoulders. It was a burden that weighed heavily initially, before a golden era late in his career during which the South American giants won three major titles, including the 2022 World Cup. The 39-year-old’s last competitive match for Argentina was the 1-0 loss to Spain in the World Cup final in July.

news.title: Lionel Messi Retires from International Football After World Cup Defeat and Father’s Death
news.lede: Lionel Messi, widely regarded as one of the greatest footballers of all time, has announced his retirement from international football, closing a glorious chapter in Argentina’s sporting history. The decision came just two days after Argentina’s defeat to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final, a loss that left millions of fans heartbroken. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Leo Messi (@leomessi) Messi revealed that the passing of his father earlier this month weighed heavily on his mind and ultimately influenced his decision to step away. “It hurts me a lot, but I know this is the right time,” he admitted, acknowledging the emotional toll of balancing personal grief with the demands of international competition.

news.title: Argentina villain Leandro Paredes hints at international retirement after 10-game ban
news.lede: Argentina’s Leandro Paredes has hinted that he could retire from international duty after being slapped with a 10-match ban. The Boca Juniors midfielder sparked an ugly brawl after the South American nation’s World Cup final defeat by Spain. He shoved Spain star Gavi to the floor and faced three FIFA assault charges. After an investigation, FIFA handed him a 10-match ban and Paredes has now suggested that he might have made his last appearance for his country due that suspension, as well as Lionel Messi’s decision to hang up his boots for Argentina.

news.title: Lee Min-sung names World Cup trio Lee Gi-hyeok, Yang Hyun-jun, Um Ji-seong to lead Korea at Asian Games - CHOSUNBIZ
news.lede: The youngest members of the North America World Cup side set out to conquer the Asian Games. The men's football Asian Games team led by coach Lee Min-sung will challenge for a fourth consecutive gold medal in men's football at the Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games. Korea competes in Group D with Saudi Arabia and Qatar. With 15 countries participating, the men's football tournament is divided into four groups, and the top two teams from each group advance to the quarterfinal knockout stage to compete for the championship.

news.title: Eto’o calls on African football federations to support FIFA chief Infantino
news.lede: Samuel Eto'o says a higher budget might have attracted the likes of Mbappe and Tchouameni to play for Africa instead.
